name: settings-button-opens-quick-settings
description: Clicking the Quick settings button opens the actual PlayerSettings scene panel.

steps.name: hasVideo
steps.note: The scene control is available before media playback, but this probe opens the menu over a live session.
Click the real Quick settings menu button.

steps.name: objectVisible
steps.note: The PlayerSettings scene panel becomes visible for the settings menu id.

assertions.note: PlayerSettings is a real in-scene panel and visibility confirms the menu was presented.
The controller observes the actual Quick menu stack as visible.
